Platforms

What happens to my Instagram when I die?

Short answer: Instagram can memorialise an account when it gets proof of death, such as an obituary. A memorialised account can't be logged into and the content stays visible to its existing audience. Verified immediate family can ask for the account to be removed instead.

What to do

  1. Anyone can submit a memorialisation request with proof of death.
  2. Immediate family can request removal with documents such as a death certificate.
  3. Back up your own photos now using Accounts Centre → 'Download your information'.

Read the official policy ↗

FAQ

Can family get into an Instagram account?

No. Instagram doesn't give out login access to memorialised accounts.

Does Instagram have a legacy contact?

Instagram supports memorialisation and removal requests. Check the current Accounts Centre settings for options.
